original_card.question: Can a template or call contract leave two or more unpaid coordinates per live family?
methods: State a replacement for the coverage identity (mass = 72W + 64N) and the contract change that realizes it, with its implementation cost.
Find an obstruction: show which data-endpoint obligation forces exactly one unpaid coordinate in the current template.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An explicit replacement identity, verified on a small complete instance with dirty inputs, priced with ceiling.ceiling(unpaid=...). A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.first_experiment: Explain where the single unpaid coordinate per family comes from in the hosted template; propose one change and price it. Ideal budget: two unpaid coordinates per family is 3.77x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The deficit is one coordinate per family minus the centre charge; doubling unpaid coordinates per family scales it directly.
allowed_variations: One template change or one endpoint-contract change.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Counting a coordinate as unpaid while leaving it unadvanced in the data endpoint.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: For each structurally nonsingular 4x4 support matrix, price the generic rational inverse support across every pair of the 56 certified matched planes and test whether a four-message joint decoder lowers the exact F2 pairing-rank invoice.
scope_change_reason: The preceding binary-basis screen found no savings but could not represent support patterns requiring nonbinary coefficients. This exact symbolic extension exhausts all 4x4 support graphs and computes generic inverse supports from structural 3x3 minors. It deliberately excludes rational specializations with cofactor cancellation and does not claim a new endpoint contract or construction.
bottleneck_link: A multi-output decoder could create additional unpaid coordinates only if its joint messages lower the copy invoice. This screen prices all generic-rational four-message support patterns on the fixed two-plane interface against the separate-plane baseline.
stop_rule: Enumerate all 65,536 4x4 binary support masks, retain every structurally nonsingular support, derive each generic inverse signature from all 3x3 cofactors, deduplicate, and price all 439 signatures on all 1,540 pairs. Stop at generic coefficients and four messages across two planes; special cancellation strata, overcomplete decoders, wider mixing and physical implementation are separate questions.
evidence: The exact replay finds 37,823 structurally nonsingular supports and 439 generic source/reader signatures. All 391 signatures induced by invertible 0/1 matrices are contained in this family; 48 additional generic signatures are present. Across 676,060 pair/signature cases every pair has minimum invoice 8, matching the separate-plane baseline, with zero strict improvements. RESULT.json binds both inputs and the pair-minima digest; selected kappa is unchanged.

open_questions.question: Can specially chosen rational coefficients with exact cofactor cancellations lower the two-plane invoice below the generic-support minimum?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The generic screen captures typical rational assignments but not matrices lying on determinantal cancellation varieties; such a matrix could have a sparser inverse and cheaper messages.
open_questions.first_step: Classify, for each 4x4 support graph, realizable zero patterns of its 3x3 cofactors while keeping the determinant and all allowed entries nonzero; first search supports with multiple cofactor matching monomials for exact rational witnesses, then price each distinct signature on all 1,540 plane pairs.
open_questions.blocked_by: Completeness of rational cancellation-stratum enumeration is unproved, and a cheaper algebraic signature still needs a priced coefficient implementation and native endpoint/restoration schedule.

submission_checkpoint.decision: Continue the assigned decoder investigation with a symbolic generic-rational support screen. The selected result and priority remain unchanged; do not infer a new frontier from this local invoice test.
